gui.about.body:
CSLModernMap Renderer  v{version}
Author: Shaotang Shaoxiancao
© 2026 Shaotang Shaoxiancao. All rights reserved

Renders modern-style maps from Cities: Skylines save files (.mmap / .cslmap).

Credits:
  · CSLMapView (kkshoko) — basis for the export format
  · TM:PE (Traffic Manager President Edition) — traffic data
  · Python / Pillow / numpy / PyYAML / Nuitka and other open-source projects

Some icon assets were collected from third-party sources and remain the property of their respective owners.

gui.layer.building_desc: Outlines of houses, equipment and other buildings. Turning this layer off noticeably speeds up rendering when the city has many buildings.
gui.layer.built_area_desc: Paints a base colour over contiguous urban areas to separate the city from the countryside.
gui.layer.district_desc: Boundaries of the districts you drew yourself.
gui.layer.hint.params: Layer visibility and the current theme parameters
gui.layer.label: District & road names
gui.layer.label_desc: Road, district and place names on the map. If they get too dense, turn categories off in Label settings….
gui.layer.land_use_desc: Colored by area type (residential / commercial / industrial)
gui.layer.metro_desc: Draws bus, tram and metro lines and stops on the normal map. For a standalone line diagram, use Public transport view.
gui.layer.po_desc: Custom objects from the Procedural Objects mod
gui.layer.poi_area_desc: Reuse building footprints and colours for interior fills without outlines. Works independently of the Buildings layer.Colours buildings by use (residential, commercial, industrial, office and so on). The Buildings layer must also be on, or the colours will not show.
gui.layer.poi_desc: Icons for hospitals, schools, stations and other places. The text on the icons is controlled separately under Text labels.
gui.layer.railway_desc: Railway, metro and other track lines — the tracks only. To see line colours and stations on the map, use Public transport.
gui.layer.road_desc: Roads of all classes, including elevated roads and tunnels. Use Settings… to adjust fill, outline and width per class.
gui.layer.terrain_desc: Shaded by elevation to show the height of hills and valleys.
gui.layer.title.label: Text labels
gui.layer.traffic_desc: Shows the road congestion snapshot saved at export time. Uses TM:PE statistics in Cities: Skylines and native traffic statistics in Cities: Skylines II.
gui.layer.transit_desc: All public transit line types found in the save
gui.layer.water_desc: Fills for lakes, rivers and other water bodies.
gui.layer.watermark_desc: Shows a watermark at the bottom left (mod name + time)
gui.layer.zone_desc: Colour blocks for parks, industry, campuses, airports, walking areas and other functional zones. Independent of Districts.
gui.layers.hint: Controls which content is shown on the map.
gui.map.hint.overview: Global settings, quick entries and an overview of the current map
gui.map.hint.range: Set the terrain area to export. This setting applies only to exported content.
gui.map.hint.resolution: Longest side of the output image in pixels. Larger is sharper, but renders slower and uses more memory.
gui.map.hint.theme: Choose the colour and line style of the map. To fine-tune individual items, use Edit Theme on the ribbon.
gui.merge.enable.tip: When off, none of the options below apply; place-icon merging is controlled here as well
gui.merge.entry.tip: Opens merging & grouping: the master switch, building / same-facility / stop merging and the various distances
gui.merge.facility.hint: Facilities are grouped by real building relations and ParkGrid areas; industrial and pedestrian zones keep their own buildings.
gui.merge.facility_area_labels.tip: Hides area names that duplicate the parent place of an airport, campus or park; industrial and pedestrian zone labels are unaffected.
gui.merge.facility_children.tip: When off, only the parent place of an airport, campus or park is shown; the facility grouping is kept.
gui.merge.facility_list.tip: Show the facility and its internal POIs. Buildings, roads and area fill remain independently controlled.
gui.merge.facility_zoom.tip: Minimum zoom at which child places appear; larger values mean you have to zoom in further. Default 1.0.
gui.merge.hint.intro: Turn on the master switch first, then tune each feature and distance

gui.metro.facility_density_hint: More facilities appear as you zoom in. With Sparse tiers, facilities appear one step later and with wider spacing.
